 "content": "def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    ones = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 1]
    twos = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 2]
    if len(ones) != 1 or len(twos) != 1:
        return out
    r, c = ones[0]
    tr, tc = twos[0]
    dr = 1 if tr > r else -1 if tr < r else 0
    dc = 1 if tc > c else -1 if tc < c else 0
    # Draw a diagonal toward the other marker, then continue along the
    # remaining axis, stopping diagonally adjacent to the 2.
    diagonal_steps = max(0, min(abs(tr-r), abs(tc-c)) - 1)
    for _ in range(diagonal_steps):
        r += dr
        c += dc
        if out[r][c] == 0:
            out[r][c] = 3
    while abs(tr-r) > 1:
        r += dr
        if out[r][c] == 0:
            out[r][c] = 3
    while abs(tc-c) > 1:
        c += dc
        if out[r][c] == 0:
            out[r][c] = 3
    return out
